newsitem.title: ITALY: Italfondiario stock to be suspended Friday.
newsitem.headline: Italfondiario stock to be suspended Friday.

text.p: Shares in Italian special credit institution Italfondiario will be suspended on the Milan stock exchange when the market reopens on Friday pending a statement, a spokesman for the bourse regulator Consob said.

Press reports said that following a failed plan to merge Italfondiario and Centrobanca, Centrobanca might be considering launching a bid offer for Italfondiario in order to create one group operating in the medium-term credit sector.
Italfondiario, Istituto Italiano di Credito Fondiario, is controlled by Istituto Centrale delle Banche Popolari and Centrobanca.
